title: Analysts Have Never Seen This Before
summary: Curated YouTube transcript reviewed as untrusted lead material. The speaker presents a Palantir post-earnings growth, valuation, technical-price, and AI-platform thesis together with a personal portfolio view. Existing registered SEC and issuer primary evidence corroborates only the already-maintained Q2 operating and guidance facts; it does not corroborate the speaker's valuation, market-price, forecast, analyst-expectation, or personal-trading assertions. No maintained conclusion, follow-up, or trading state changed.
